question_text: Darlene loves to cook with fresh herbs. So, she decides to plant 8 different herbs and keep the small pots on her kitchen windowsill. She starts with a 2-kilogram bag of soil and puts the same amount of soil in each pot. If she uses all of the soil, how many grams does she add to each pot?
solution: You want to find how many grams of soil Darlene adds to each pot.
Darlene starts with 2 kilograms of soil. Note that there are 1000 grams in a kilogram, so multiply 2 kilograms by 1000 to get the amount of soil Darlene starts with in grams.
Now we know Darlene has 2000 grams in total and there are 8 pots. To find how many grams of soil go into each pot, we divide the amount of soil by the number of pots.
